title: South Florida nightlife this week
igCaption:
Start with dinner, then pick the neighborhood.

Sources: Miami New Times, Secret Miami

#MiamiNightlife #SouthFlorida #Brickell #LittleRiver

scenes.text: Want a night out this week without a long commute between stops?
Start in Brickell at LPM Restaurant and Bar. It just finished a $3 million transformation with an expanded patio, a dedicated patio entrance, and a new cocktail program called Déjà Vu.
scenes.caption: Start in Brickell at LPM Restaurant & Bar. It just finished a $3 million transformation with an expanded patio, a dedicated patio entrance, and a new cocktail program called Déjà Vu.

scenes.text: Next is Anako in Little River. It opened October 22 at 8222 NE Second Avenue, from chefs Leicel Ros and Nancy Dominguez, the couple behind Sili at 1-800-Lucky.
scenes.caption: Next is Anako in Little River. It opened Oct. 22 at 8222 NE 2nd Ave., from chefs Leicel Ros and Nancy Dominguez, the couple behind Sili at 1-800-Lucky.

scenes.text: The opening menu goes deeper than snacks. Anako serves pork and whole Gulf shrimp lumpia, kinilaw crudo with Japanese hiramasa, chicken inasal, sisig, and kare-kare with slow-braised oxtail. If you're at Anako, check NEAR and see who else came for sisig.

scenes.text: For a farther dinner plan, Pastis opened in West Palm Beach this October. It sits on the ground floor of the 201-room Nora Hotel, and this is the restaurant’s fifth location.

scenes.text: Which one would you actually do this week? A night out is full of faces you notice and never meet, and NEAR is what turns that missed connection into a name.
